_note: Combat Patrol force definition. This is a SEPARATE game mode: a fixed force with its own datasheets (in data/combat-patrol/units/) and its own stratagems, which deliberately never mix with the matched-play data in data/units/ and data/stratagems.json. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader.
name: Orks Combat Patrol
_detachment_help: The single detachment this force runs. Unlike matched play there is no budget to spend — the DP cost is shown for reference. `category` keys into the colour map in data/detachments.json.

detachment.name: 'Ard As Nails
detachment.ruleDescription: Attacks that target a friendly 'ARDMOB unit with the Waaagh! active with a S greater than that friendly unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

_roster_help: The fixed force, in the order it should display. Each entry is either a plain unit id, or an object: {"unit":"id", "count":2, "ledBy":"character-id", "note":"free text"}. ledBy fixes an attachment; for an attachment the player chooses each game, use leaderChoice below instead. Unit files are loaded from this list automatically — add an explicit "units" array only if you need a datasheet that is not in the roster.
_leaderChoice_help: An attachment the player picks each game rather than one the force fixes. Exactly one of `leaders` may be attached, to exactly one of the roster entries it can lead. Omit this key entirely and the choice UI disappears.

leaderChoice.prompt: Select one Leader to attach to an 'Ardmob Boyz unit.

_enhancements_help: Combat Patrol enhancements. `limit` is how many may be active at once. `restrictedTo` gates which unit it goes on and is what puts the star on that unit's card. `effects` are applied to the target unit's displayed profile, and the changed values are highlighted.

rallying-war-cry.name: Rallying War Cry
rallying-war-cry.description: 'ARDMOB WARBOSS model only. (Once per battle, per unit) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, return up to D3+2 destroyed bodyguard models to this unit.

extra-platin.name: Extra Platin'
extra-platin.description:
Upgrade: 'ARDMOB WARTRAKK unit only. This unit has:
• 3+ Sv.
• 4+ InSv.

_stratagems_note: This force's stratagems are the core ones in data/stratagems.json, shown on the Stratagems tab. The Combat Patrol tab deliberately has no stratagem panel of its own.
